# AMGCUBE

AMGCUBE PTY LTD (AMGCUBE) is a QBCC-licensed granny flat builder designing and building secondary dwellings across Brisbane and South East Queensland. Each project is shaped around the specific block, including site access, slope, services and planning constraints. Typical builds are 60–100 m² with 1 to 3 bedrooms, priced from $250,000 AUD including design, engineering, approvals, construction and handover. A completed display home is open by appointment at 146 Dowding Street, Oxley, Brisbane.

## Key facts

- QBCC Licence: 15616213 (Builder – Low Rise)
- Member: Master Builders Queensland
- Location: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia
- Service area: Brisbane and South East Queensland
- Phone: +61 458 533 333 or email: info@amgcube.com
